content: {"reasoning": "Prior authorization is required and missing, and silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review, so there is no way to cure the auth defect before billing. The claim data itself is correct (valid code pairing, correct COB order, active eligibility, AOB on file), so there is nothing to correct, and no denial is yet on the table to appeal; billing the patient or writing off would forfeit collectible allowed dollars for a provider-liability auth issue.
